projects.summary: Skill set whose subagents and panels dispatch across Claude, GPT, and Grok through T3 Code's official MCP tools; its README says it works only inside T3.
projects.summary_zh: 经 T3 Code 官方 MCP 工具调度多模型子代理与面板的 Skill 套件；其 README 说明仅在 T3 内运行。

projects.non_affiliation: Unofficial. Not affiliated with Anthropic or T3.
projects.summary: Single-file Claude-inspired theme using T3's built-in theme and Custom CSS system (no fork). Warns that updates may break rules targeting internal attributes.
projects.summary_zh: 基于 T3 内置主题与 Custom CSS 的单文件类 Claude 主题（无需 fork）；README 提示其依赖内部属性，升级可能需适配。

projects.summary: macOS desktop heads-up display and desk pet that reads live thread state through T3 Code's official MCP server.
projects.summary_zh: 通过 T3 Code 官方 MCP 服务器读取实时线程状态的 macOS 桌面 HUD 与桌宠工具。

projects.non_affiliation: Not affiliated with or endorsed by T3 Tools Inc. or Clerk.
projects.summary: Stdio MCP gateway that discovers T3 Connect machines and forwards calls to each machine's official T3 MCP tools (each machine still requires its own OAuth approval).
projects.summary_zh: 发现 T3 Connect 各台机器并转发到各机官方 T3 MCP 工具的 stdio 网关（每台机器仍需各自完成 OAuth 授权）。

projects.summary: Dark theme with restrained multicolor accents imported directly through Settings → Appearance → Add a theme.
projects.summary_zh: 带克制多色点缀的深色主题，通过「设置 → 外观 → 添加主题」直接导入。

reference.reason: Uses T3 Code's internal local websocket API and read-only SQLite access while migrating toward the official MCP server and CLI, so it sits outside the official-entries-only mount standard today.
reference.reason_zh: 当前依赖 T3 Code 内部本地 WebSocket API 与只读 SQLite（正在向官方 MCP 与 CLI 迁移），暂不符合“仅官方开放入口”标准，仅作参考。
